subtitle: Recorded from https://solvay-sparkai.ivolve.cloud/demo as a regular user; the India customer returns document is synthetic

scenes.vo: Hello, and welcome. In the next few minutes, I'll show you how to run an analysis with the Fit-Gap Copilot in Spark AI Spine.

scenes.caption: Go to solvay-sparkai.ivolve.cloud/demo and sign in
scenes.screen: Sign-in page: type the username and password, click Sign in, land on the home page, point at the Spine and Fit-Gap Copilot tabs.
scenes.vo: To get started, open your browser and go to solvay-sparkai.ivolve.cloud/demo. Enter the username and password you were given, then click Sign in. After you sign in, you'll land on the home page. At the top, you'll see two tabs: Spine and Fit-Gap Copilot.

scenes.caption: Spine: the knowledge graph built from Solvay's documents
scenes.screen: Spine graph: point at the graph, then at Business Streams, Core Systems and BPML Processes in the filter list.
scenes.vo: Before we run the analysis, let's take a quick look at Spine. This is a knowledge graph built from the documents that Solvay shared with us. It shows how the business streams, core systems and BPML processes connect to one another.

scenes.caption: Fit-Gap Copilot: attach the country document, add focus, run
scenes.screen: Fit-Gap Copilot: Sources, attach India_Customer_Returns_As_Is.txt and hold on the processing; Scope, type instructions; Run analysis; Investigation and Logs; Stop; History, load the finished run.
scenes.vo: Now let's open the Fit-Gap Copilot. In the Sources section, attach your country document, the one that describes how the process runs in that country today. You can upload PDF, Word, Excel, PowerPoint or text files. For this demo, I'll attach the India customer returns document from my desktop. As soon as the file is attached, the app reads it and prepares it for analysis. The document is compared against Solvay's Global Template and SAP Best Practices. In the Scope section, you can add instructions to focus the analysis on a particular area, for example approval thresholds or e-invoicing. When you're ready, click Run analysis. The agent starts working right away. You can see what the agents are doing in the Investigation section; click Logs to see each step in detail. A full analysis takes around ten minutes, so let's stop this run and open one I completed earlier from History.

scenes.caption: The results: Summary, Deviations and the Workshop agenda
scenes.screen: A finished run loaded from History: Summary scores, then the Deviations tab, then the Workshop agenda tab.
scenes.vo: When the analysis is complete, the results are organized into tabs. The Summary shows how closely the country's process aligns with the Global Template. Deviations lists each gap that was found, and the Workshop agenda shows the items that need a decision. Every finding stays proposed until someone on your team reviews and accepts it.
And that's it: you've seen how to run a Fit-Gap Copilot analysis, from attaching your document to reviewing the results. Thank you for watching.
